gloss: either one; one or the other

definitions.gloss: either one; one or the other; which one
definitions.explanation: A colloquial contraction of どちらか, used when choosing between two options. Can function as a question ('which one?') or as a statement ('one of the two').

examples.japanese: どっちか⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。

examples.english: If I had to choose, I'd say I prefer movies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{青|あお}→青：02841_ao⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧どっちかにして⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧？⟦どっちでもいい→どっちでもいい：28670_docchidemoii⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧⟦{決|き}めて→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Can you pick either the red one or the blue one? I don't care which, so just decide quickly.

notes:
A colloquial contraction of ⟦どちらか→どちらか：28669_dochiraka⟧ (which one of the two; either one). Very common in casual spoken Japanese. The full form ⟦どちらか→どちらか：28669_dochiraka⟧ is used in polite or formal speech.

The expression どっちか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧ (if I had to say which; if anything) is an extremely common hedging phrase used to express a mild preference.

USAGE:
- どっちか⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: pick one (of two)
- どっちか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧: if I had to choose; if anything
- どっちか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on one or the other

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦どちらか→どちらか：28669_dochiraka⟧: either one — the polite/formal equivalent
- ⟦どっち→どっち：02922_docchi⟧: which one (of two) — the informal question form without ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧
- ⟦どれか→どれか：22606_doreka⟧: any one (of three or more) — for selecting from more than two options
- ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧: which one (of two) — the polite form of ⟦どっち→どっち：02922_docchi⟧
